scope: Original neutral reconstruction of a standard clear-tray PlayStation jewel case, suitable for the original US black-label Crash Bandicoot SCUS-94900 presentation.

sources.type: Jewel-case manufacturer inspection criteria and component drawings
observations: CMC lists the assembled A dimension as 142.20–142.50 mm, B as 124.60–124.90 mm, and C as 10.40 ± 0.2 mm.
The page includes lid, bottom, standard tray and clear tray diagrams and inspection ranges.
sources.usedFor: 142.35 × 124.75 × 10.4 mm nominal envelope chosen at the midpoints of the assembly ranges.
sources.limitations: These are CMC product specifications, not evidence of the exact Sony supplier or mold used for a particular Crash Bandicoot printing. Fine features in the reconstruction remain approximate.

sources.type: Original physical US black-label Crash Bandicoot specimen photographs
observations: The inspected photographs show a standard clear tray and US SCUS-94900 markings.
The listing metadata labels the region PAL, which conflicts with the visible specimen markings; the photographs rather than the listing category establish the selected presentation.
sources.usedFor: Clear-tray construction and edition-family cross-check, not dimensional measurements.
sources.limitations: The seller photograph is reference evidence only; it is not embedded or redistributed in the neutral template.

artworkContract.wrapLayout: 138 mm center panel and two 6.5 mm spine folds; dimensions are approximate paper-fit targets, not a print-ready specification.

knownApproximations: Fine molded ribbing, clip positions, hub spring geometry and booklet leaves are reconstructed visual approximations.
Blank booklet pages are dimensional placeholders, not a reproduction of a specific manual pagination.
Transparent molded plastic is rendered through portable material approximations and may differ across engines.
No disc is included; the existing standalone media model remains a separate asset.
rights: Only original parametric geometry and authored metadata are distributed in this neutral template. Product design and third-party marks remain outside the collection license; no source photograph, game artwork or copied logo is embedded.
